0022600116.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder, 2-0 and first in the Northwest, host the 1-0 LA Clippers, who lead the Pacific, in the Thunder's third game of the 2026-27 season. Oklahoma City will be without Nikola Topic (back, surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles, surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee, surgery), while the Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), Max Strus (foot, plantar fasciitis), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery). The Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 128-110 win in Los Angeles on April 8, 2026, and this season's series has no games yet.
